description: Single-threaded Callgrind profiles of the SyncExpanseStrMap, SyncExpanseBytesMap and SyncExpanseBlobMap mutation arms of crates/expanse/benches/instructions.rs and of their plain-map counterparts (Refs #929, step 2, Callgrind half). Read by scripts/callgrind_wrapper_ranking.py.

provenance.source: git archive of the commit, unmodified
provenance.platform: x86_64 Linux, Docker container (Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS, glibc 2.39-0ubuntu8.9) on a development host, not the reference benchmark host
provenance.build_profile: bench profile as committed; no CARGO_PROFILE_* or EXPANSE_* override (EXPANSE_BRANCH_SIM unset, so no branch simulation); the build CI's instruction-counts job runs
provenance.callgrind_args: iai-callgrind defaults plus the harness's --cache-sim=yes (bench_config in instructions.rs)
provenance.container: docker run --rm --security-opt seccomp=unconfined -e CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/t -e CARGO_TERM_COLOR=never -w /w <ubuntu:24.04 image with rustup 1.98.1, valgrind, iai-callgrind-runner 0.16.1>
provenance.what_is_counted: Ir: instructions retired inside the benchmark function (the region iai-callgrind collects; setup excluded). Deterministic for a given binary and environment; no interval (AGENTS.md section 8.4). The ranking reads Ir only.
provenance.cache_columns: Left as callgrind wrote them and not read by the ranking. Each log records valgrind deriving the LL simulation from the host's L3 (a 48,234,496 B, 23-way simulated LL), while the listing header prints an 8,388,608 B, 16-way LL; the two disagree, so no LL column is interpreted.
provenance.ci_counts: These are the development container's counts, not the CI instruction-counts job's. The canonical regression figures stay CI's.
